description: This plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different configurations during Whisper model fine-tuning. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “WER” and has a linear scale ranging from 24 to 42.5, with tick labels at 25, 27.5, 30, 32.5, 35, 37.5, 40 and 42.5. A solid orange line, representing “small AdaLoRA_int4”, begins at approximately 37.5 at epoch 0, declines to approximately 30 at epoch 3, then declines to approximately 27 at epoch 6. A dashed orange line, representing “small int4”, begins at approximately 35 at epoch 0, declines to approximately 27.5 at epoch 2, further declines to approximately 25 at epoch 5, and ends at approximately 25.5 at epoch 6. A dashed brown line, representing “small int8”, begins at approximately 30 at epoch 0, declines to approximately 28 at epoch 3, declines to approximately 26.5 at epoch 5, and ends at approximately 26 at epoch 6.
